neighbours.label: A piece of a rare multi-token noun naming a body of people or institution (pre|achers, ke|beles, Ap|el|aciones), vs common single-token nouns in the same slot
fire: Last spring the regional governors summoned the district kebeles to a meeting.
Residents said the travelling preachers had stayed in the village for a week.
On Monday the Tribunal de Apelaciones overturned the earlier ruling.
The army arrested two wandering preachers outside the market.
Aid workers coordinated food deliveries through the local kebeles.
Lawyers expect the Corte de Apelaciones to hear the case next month.
Several popular preachers were banned from speaking at the mosque.
In the highlands each family registers with one of the kebeles.
quiet: Last spring the regional governors summoned the district mayors to a meeting.
Residents said the travelling singers had stayed in the village for a week.
On Monday the high court overturned the earlier ruling.
The army arrested two wandering soldiers outside the market.
Aid workers coordinated food deliveries through the local schools.
Lawyers expect the supreme court to hear the case next month.
Several popular teachers were banned from speaking at the school.
In the highlands each family registers with one of the villages.
